context: Change the ANCHOR, not the directory name. In resolve_benchmark_runs_dir(), when the resolved root is still the bare DEFAULT_BENCHMARK_RUNS_ROOT sentinel, walk up from Path.cwd() for a '.git' entry (a directory in a clone, a FILE in a linked worktree — both must be accepted via .exists()) and return <worktree_root>.parent / 'benchmark_runs'. When cwd is not inside a work tree (installed package, arbitrary cwd) keep returning Path.cwd() / 'benchmark_runs' so published behaviour for non-repo users is byte-identical. Precedence --output > BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR > default must be untouched: resolve_benchmark_runs_root() and the explicit/env branches keep their current semantics, and only the default branch changes. Guard against the degenerate case where the work tree root is the filesystem root (parent == self) by falling back to cwd. Then rewrite the ~13 tests that assert the literal cwd path so they assert against the resolved default root instead of a hardcoded shape, and add a positive regression test that the resolved default is never contained in a Git work tree.
description: benchbox/core/runtime_paths.py::DEFAULT_BENCHMARK_RUNS_ROOT is the RELATIVE Path('benchmark_runs'), and benchbox/utils/path_utils.py::resolve_benchmark_runs_dir anchors that fallback to Path.cwd(). benchbox/cli/config.py::DirectoryManager.__init__ then eagerly mkdirs results/, datagen/ and databases/ under it. Consequence: any `uv run benchbox run` launched from a checkout with no BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR set writes generated data, loaded databases and result JSONs INTO that checkout. Verified on 2026-07-24 @ 14b0271c1: the main clone held 1.9 GB of in-tree artifacts (datagen 1.0 G, databases 936 M, results 704 K) from a 2026-07-24 08:18-08:40 multi-platform session, while the intended shared root /Users/joe/Developer/benchmark_runs received nothing from that day. Direct probe from a scratch cwd returned `resolve_benchmark_runs_dir() = <cwd>/benchmark_runs`. The maintainer convention is `../benchmark_runs` — a SIBLING of the checkout — which works uniformly because every pool worktree (BenchBox.pool-NN, BenchBox.findings-pN) is itself a sibling of the main clone. Both existing guards miss the no-env case: tests/unit/core/test_benchmark_output_root_guard.py only forbids HARDCODED Path.cwd()/'benchmark_runs' in benchmark sources (it enforces routing through the very helper that is cwd-relative), and tests/uat/artifact_hygiene.py::configured_external_root is a no-op when BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR is unset. .env.example:81 actively recommends the in-repo path (`BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR=./benchmark_runs`).

anti_patterns.instead: Anchor to the enclosing work tree's parent, which yields exactly ../benchmark_runs for the main clone and every sibling pool worktree
anti_patterns.why: It orphans the existing 1.9 GB+ corpus at /Users/joe/Developer/benchmark_runs and abandons the established ../benchmark_runs sibling convention

anti_patterns.dont: Detect the work tree by shelling out to `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`
anti_patterns.instead: Walk cwd and its parents in pure Python for an existing '.git' entry, accepting both the directory and the linked-worktree file form
anti_patterns.why: Adds a subprocess to a hot path that runs during benchmark construction and fails when git is absent from the environment

anti_patterns.dont: Test the new behaviour by asserting a literal absolute path such as /Users/joe/Developer/benchmark_runs
anti_patterns.instead: Assert the relationship — the resolved root is not inside a Git work tree, and equals <worktree_root>.parent/'benchmark_runs' for a fixture repo
anti_patterns.why: That re-pins the tests to one machine's layout, the same brittleness that let the cwd default survive this long

preserves.behavior: A cwd that is NOT inside a Git work tree still resolves to Path.cwd()/'benchmark_runs', so installed-package users see no change
All pool worktrees and the main clone continue to resolve to the SAME shared root, preserving datagen reuse across checkouts
BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR continues to be expanduser()'d and to accept both relative and absolute values
DirectoryManager still creates results/, datagen/ and databases/ under whatever root is resolved
Resolution precedence stays explicit --output > BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR > default; neither the explicit nor the env branch changes behaviour
The directory name stays 'benchmark_runs' so the existing /Users/joe/Developer/benchmark_runs corpus and every BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR-based UAT flow keep working

resolve_benchmark_runs_dir absolutises the relative default for filesystem callers
